body: Feature-6632 [https://github.com/hoppscotch/hoppscotch/issues/6632#issuecomment-5599319582](url) When testing APIs, developers often need to compare response payloads across different test runs, environments, or request tabs. Previously, users had to copy responses into third-party tools to inspect differences. This PR introduces a native side-by-side response comparison modal directly inside Hoppscotch for both REST and GraphQL API clients. ### What's changed - Added a "Compare" button in the response metadata header next to status code, response time, and payload size. - Created `HttpResponseCompareModal.vue` and `GqlResponseCompareModal.vue` components to render a side-by-side visual line diff. - Added target selection options to compare the active response against other open request tabs or raw JSON input. - Displays metadata comparison (Status, Time, and Size) side-by-side at the top of the modal. - Wired `@compare` event handlers in both REST and GraphQL response view components. - Added locale entry in `en.json` and registered components in `components.d.ts`. ### Notes to reviewers - The feature works for both REST (`/`) and GraphQL (`/graphql`) request panes. - Dual tab lookup is included in the GraphQL comparison modal to handle both standalone GraphQL tabs (`GQLTabService`) and unified workspace tabs (`WorkspaceTabsService`). - All changes have been verified with `pnpm typecheck` across the workspace without any errors. --- ## Summary by cubic Implements [Feature-6632](https://github.com/hoppscotch/hoppscotch/issues/6632) by adding native response comparison to REST and GraphQL clients. Users can now compare the current response with another open request tab or pasted input instead of using a third-party tool. **Details** - Adds a Compare button beside response status, time, and size. - Shows responses side by side with added and removed lines highlighted. - Displays status, duration, and size for both responses. - Adds localized Compare text and session caching for the last 30 executed REST responses. Written for commit 5eea64fd209addde0d770831b7234817eb339699. Summary will update on new commits.
